c74object.name: j.ui
c74object.description: j.ui shows the address of the model of its patcher (or of the model a j.view in it is bound to), a menu of what is below the model, and its presets. A click on the address opens the menu of parameters, messages and returns; the menu arrow opens the utilities and presets menu. While there is no model it says that it is waiting for one.

method.name: dump
method.description: The dump message answers model:address and the address (or model:waiting), preset:count and the number of presets, presets and their names and preset:current and the current preset, out the outlet.

method.name: paint
method.description: Sent by Max when the panel is drawn.

method.name: mouseup
method.description: A click on the header opens the menu of nodes (on the address) or the utilities and presets menu (on the arrow).

attribute.name: tags
attribute.description: Accepted so that old patchers load; it has no effect yet.
